action.objective: Verify d2c3 recapture, consolidating the bishop pair and keeping the position solid
action.rationale: Broad search (all moves, depth 3, exact) rated d2c3 best at -249; b2xc3 was worse (-285, upper bound). d2xc3 restores material, removes the active Black bishop, and leaves Black to develop (e8g8). Single-candidate verification at max depth 4 is needed before committing, since the prior score is only depth 3 and the row is an unverified exact bound.
